missions.title: The Disputed Rice Fields
missions.desc: A century of disputed grants has left the same rice fields owing tax to several lords. We must measure the land, improve our domain, and restore a survey that collectors and cultivators can both obey.
missions.trigger:
grown_by_development = 10
capital_scope = { base_tax = 3 }

missions.title: Recall the Retainers
missions.desc: The old muster rolls name households that have deserted, divided, or sold their service. We must secure fresh military commitments and assemble a force worthy of the summons.
missions.highlight_reason: Estate commitments and national army strength.

missions.title: Recover the Imperial Seals
missions.desc: Officials still invoke imperial seals whose registers were lost during the feuds. We must rebuild the institutions that preserve these records and give the court a seat capable of enforcing them.

missions.title: Witnesses at Dawn
missions.desc: Debtors whisper of patrons who receive visitors only after sunset, but no magistrate will hear them alone. We must establish a capable intelligence service and build a case against the hidden households.

missions.title: Envoys to the Clans
missions.desc: Every clan keeps its own account of promises broken during the civil wars. We must obtain public commitments from surviving neighbours, or bring their domains under a government they can no longer defy.

missions.title: Measure the Dragon
missions.desc: Cathayan courts have learned to treat our quarrelling lords as petitioners and convenient clients. We must learn who commands their coast before presenting demands of our own.

missions.title: Break the Blood Debts
missions.desc: Private blood debts have placed magistrates and castle towns in the service of rival households. We must end these purchased loyalties through public courts, either breaking the vampiric creditors or binding them beneath a single vampiric authority.

missions.title: Oaths Above Bloodlines
missions.desc: Retainers obey their houses before the common command, leaving every campaign hostage to an old quarrel. We must bind officers to a shared service and make the muster independent of private feuds.
missions.highlight_reason: Professionalism, estate loyalty, crown land, and army tradition.

missions.title: Refit the War Harbours
missions.desc: Rotting slips and unpaid crews have left our ports dependent on foreign protection. We must rebuild the docks and place a seaworthy fleet at the service of the realm.

missions.title: Schools of the Sword
missions.desc: Famous duellists cannot hold a battle line by reputation alone. We must make disciplined practice part of the army and teach our warriors to prevail together.
missions.trigger:
army_tradition = 25
num_of_regiments_at_full_drill = 10

missions.title: Pacify the Court
missions.desc: Temples, officials, and warrior houses issue commands that cancel one another before they reach the provinces. We must establish a durable settlement at court and the authority to enforce it.
missions.trigger:
stability = 2
crown_land_share = 40

missions.title: Guard the Inland Sea
missions.desc: Each disputed anchorage gives raiders another place to provision and merchants another reason to stay away. We must protect the ships that carry rice, weapons, and revenue between our ports.
missions.trigger:
home_trade_node = { trade_share = { country = ROOT share = 40 } }
num_of_light_ship = 5
missions.highlight_reason: Protect-trade fleet and home-node trade share; no province ownership objective.

missions.title: Cleanse the Shrines
missions.desc: Rival cults have turned the shrines into sanctuaries for defiance against the court. We must bring every province of our Nipponese domain into our own faith and bind the temples to a common religious order.

missions.title: Sword and Seal
missions.desc: Imperial decrees and military commands have again begun to reach the same castles, but their authority remains unsettled. We must decide how the sword will uphold the seal before the reunification can endure.
missions.trigger:
government_rank = 2
legitimacy_equivalent = 95
is_at_war = yes
missions.highlight_reason: Government rank, legitimacy equivalent, and an active war.

missions.title: No Tribute to Dragons
missions.desc: Cathayan protocol still places our envoys beneath rulers whose fleets once profited from our weakness. We must present a court and a navy that make such treatment costly.
missions.trigger:
diplomatic_reputation = 2
num_of_heavy_ship = 10

missions.title: Reopen the Roads
missions.desc: Goblins and armed toll-keepers have inherited the passes abandoned by the clans. We must secure the roads between our castles and make it possible for orders and grain to travel safely.

missions.title: Armies of Reunification
missions.desc: The court can summon warriors, but a long campaign still empties villages and exhausts private stores. We must establish permanent recruitment districts capable of sustaining the restoration.

missions.title: A Cathayan Harbor
missions.desc: Our ships can cross to Cathay, but they have no safe place to repair or disembark an army. We must secure a defended mainland harbour from which our demands carry weight.
missions.trigger:
num_of_transport = 10
num_of_provinces_owned_or_owned_by_non_sovereign_subjects_with = {
	superregion = cathay_superregion
	has_port = yes
	war_nippon_fort = yes
	value = 1
}

missions.title: Across the Serpent Sea
missions.desc: Khureshi raiders know which harbours change hands with every clan war. We must learn the routes to their own shore and prepare ships that can carry the contest back to them.

missions.title: One Muster, Many Banners
missions.desc: Former enemies now march beside one another while their officers still maintain separate rolls and stores. We must bring their contingents into one professional muster without wasting their hard-won experience.
missions.trigger:
OR = { army_professionalism = 0.25 has_country_modifier = war_modern_army }
has_leader_with = { general = yes total_pips = 8 }
missions.highlight_reason: Professionalism and a general with at least eight total pips.

missions.title: Restore Grand Nippon
missions.desc: The surviving domains can no longer sustain the pretence that Nippon is merely a gathering of rival courts. We must unite every province of the islands under our own rule or that of our subjects, giving the restored imperial authority a realm to govern.
missions.trigger:
war_nippon_islands_united = yes
is_at_war = no
missions.highlight:
is_sea = no
is_wasteland = no
has_discovered = ROOT
region = nippon_region
NOT = { country_or_non_sovereign_subject_holds = ROOT }

missions.title: Break the Serpent Court
missions.desc: The serpent courts have mistaken our divisions for a permanent weakness. We must place five provinces of Khuresh under our own rule or that of our subjects, establishing a lasting answer to their predation.

missions.title: End the Century of Night
missions.desc: The long fracture has left rival faiths and defiant lords behind the borders of the reunited realm. We must bring the settled islands under loyal authority and a common faith, ending the divisions that sustained a century of night.
missions.trigger:
is_at_war = no
war_nippon_homeland_restored = yes
missions.highlight:
is_sea = no
is_wasteland = no
has_discovered = ROOT
region = nippon_region
is_city = yes
NOT = { AND = { war_nippon_controlled_province = yes religion = ROOT } }

missions.title: An Empire Acknowledged
missions.desc: Our seals now bind the islands, but foreign courts still address us as one claimant among many. We must secure recognition beyond Nippon and choose how that standing will serve the restored empire.

missions.title: Humble the Dragon
missions.desc: Cathayan ministers have measured our petitions for generations without measuring the men who carry them. We must secure eight provinces of Cathay under our authority and establish a reputation that its courts can no longer dismiss.

missions.title: Beneath the Old Shrines
missions.desc: The restoration has reopened sealed storehouses and forgotten stairways beneath the old sanctuaries. We must build three shrine towns into centers capable of supporting an expedition and appoint an experienced administrator to organize their records and supplies.

missions.title: Veterans of the Restoration
missions.desc: The restoration has produced soldiers accustomed to difficult marches and uncertain loyalties. We must organize experienced officers and reliable stores for expeditions beyond the familiar roads.
missions.trigger:
army_tradition = 60
manpower_percentage = 0.50

missions.title: Survey the Reunited Realm
missions.desc: Reunification has placed incompatible surveys and tax registers under one government. We must extend cultivation and reconcile the records so that the empire can support its new ambitions.

missions.title: Charter the Ocean Voyages
missions.desc: Victories along the eastern coast have opened a horizon our divided clans could never pursue. We must assemble fifty ships and build ocean-going yards before chartering permanent expeditions and commissioning explorers.
missions.unpriced_unlock: may_explore = yes: explicitly requested; no Weighing Value is given in the Balance Guide.

missions.title: The First Descent
missions.desc: Maps and lanterns have brought our soldiers to the threshold of the underground world. We must establish a defensible settlement whose garrison can survive when the surface roads are cut.

missions.title: Arts of Peace
missions.desc: A restored empire needs magistrates, scholars, and prosperous towns as surely as it needs swords. We must deepen learning and develop cities where those arts can flourish.

missions.title: Pilots from Distant Shores
missions.desc: Our new ships still depend on charts copied from uncertain accounts. We must cultivate a trusted foreign maritime partner and turn borrowed knowledge into practiced navigation.

missions.title: Beyond the Sunrise
missions.desc: The sea beyond the familiar islands is beginning to acquire names on our charts. We must secure a completed settlement in Lustria or Naggaroth, whether governed directly or entrusted to a subject.

missions.title: Lantern Garrisons
missions.desc: A single underground outpost is only an isolated camp waiting to be overwhelmed. We must establish defended stations with enough stores and men to keep the approaches open.

missions.title: Break the Burrow-Kings
missions.desc: The powers below the mountains treat every new garrison as prey or tribute. We must wrest eight settled underground provinces into our domain, giving our commanders the territory needed to resist the burrow-kings.

missions.title: Factories of the Realm
missions.desc: Distant armies and growing ports now demand more than the old castle workshops can supply. We must establish industries across the homeland that can sustain imperial service and civilian prosperity alike.

missions.title: The First Overseas Han
missions.desc: Our foothold beyond the ocean has opened disputes over who will govern the lands around it. We must bring five settled provinces in Lustria or Naggaroth under our authority and decide whether their future rests with governors or chartered merchants.

missions.title: Roads Below the Roots
missions.desc: The garrisons can hold their walls, but disputes over mines and supply roads now reach the surface court. We must establish a working underground administration and choose how it will govern the frontier.

missions.title: Sword Schools of the Empire
missions.desc: The men who fought below the earth possess lessons that no isolated clan school could have taught. We must bring that experience into an imperial system of training and preserve it beyond one generation.
missions.trigger:
OR = { army_professionalism = 0.50 has_country_modifier = war_modern_army }
army_tradition = 60

missions.title: An Embassy in Nipponsstad
missions.desc: Nipponese merchants have long sought a place among the trading houses of the western world. We must sustain an embassy at Marienburg, or an equivalent surviving western port, and make its court a dependable partner.

missions.title: Towns Across the Ocean
missions.desc: A lone overseas domain cannot protect the routes on which it depends. We must extend our authority over ten settled provinces in Lustria or Naggaroth, giving our overseas communities the reach to sustain one another.

missions.title: Dawn in the Deep Places
missions.desc: The underground frontier has ceased to be a succession of expeditions and emergency garrisons. We must make it a secure domain whose developed settlements contribute lasting wealth to the empire.

missions.title: The Imperial Palaces
missions.desc: Our rulers have recovered the authority of their predecessors, but the imperial seat still bears the marks of decline. We must restore the great palaces and build a city worthy of the realm they now govern.
missions.trigger:
4780 = { owned_by = ROOT development = 40 has_great_project = { type = nippon_imperial_palaces tier = 3 } }
capital_scope = { province_id = 4780 }

missions.title: A Nippon Beyond the Sea
missions.desc: The overseas towns now contain families who know Nippon through the laws, letters, and ships we send them. We must gather twenty settled provinces in Lustria or Naggaroth into our own domain or those of our subjects, making Nippon a lasting presence across the sea.

missions.title: The Sword of the Rising Sun
missions.desc: Our warriors have carried their discipline into caverns and distant campaigns that defeated the methods of the old clan armies. We must turn that experience into an elite force whose reputation rests on practiced excellence.

missions.title: A Hundred Banners
missions.desc: Foreign envoys now come to Nippon seeking decisions that matter beyond our islands. We must sustain a court whose reputation, ceremony, and reliability make those embassies worth maintaining.

missions.title: Equals of the Ancient Powers
missions.desc: Our distant domains have made Nippon impossible to dismiss, but lasting standing requires durable partners. We must bind major foreign powers to relationships that can survive the end of a single campaign.

missions.title: Proof of Superiority
missions.desc: The ancient powers still proclaim their greatness through the relics of vanished heroes and empires. We must gather fourteen of these artifacts into our own keeping, making their accumulated glory the proof of Nipponese superiority. With the treasures of distant thrones and sacred places assembled under our authority, Nippon shall become the center of the world.

events:
The assembled officials lay the recovered seals on a low table before the captains of the victorious houses. Beside them rests a sword presented as the emblem of the old shogunal command. Both objects have drawn obedience before, but never from every lord in the room.

The chamberlain proposes that appointments and treaties proceed through the restored court. The senior captains instead demand a military settlement that binds every household to a single chain of command. [Root.Monarch.GetName] must decide which institution will carry the greater burden of reunification.
Let the court bind the houses.
Let the sword enforce the settlement.

Foreign envoys gather for the first audience held under the restored imperial protocol. Their gifts arrive with carefully revised letters that finally acknowledge the authority exercised from [Root.Capital.GetName]. The interpreters inspect every title before the doors are opened.

Some councillors want these embassies to begin a wider reconciliation. Their rivals argue that recognition should make the lesser courts easier to draw into our own administration.

The audience cannot promise both policies with equal conviction. [Root.Monarch.GetName] must give the ambassadors a clear account of the empire they are recognizing.
Let the lesser courts join our order.

A convoy returns from the underground stations carrying ore, casualty rolls, and three incompatible sets of toll accounts. The captains have kept their roads open, but each now claims authority over the settlements supplied through his gates. Merchants refuse to send another convoy until the court establishes whose seals they must honour.

The frontier commanders request a permanent military jurisdiction built around the fortified stations. The magistrates offer an alternative of surveyed mining domains and regular civil accounts. Both proposals promise order, though each will shape a different society beneath the mountains.
The garrisons shall hold the frontier.
The magistrates shall govern the mines.

The first overseas domains send a delegation with a plan of its harbour and a chest of local timber. Their inhabitants have endured the first changes of rule and now demand a government that will survive the next governor. The delegates wait in travel-stained robes while their petition is read.

Veteran officers propose hereditary overseas domains whose households owe service to the imperial centre. The merchants who supplied the crossing request chartered settlements governed through their accounts and trading privileges.

Both groups have earned a hearing, and both expect their investment to be repaid. [Root.Monarch.GetName] must decide which form of obligation will bind the new shore to Nippon.
Grant charters to the merchant settlements.

tooltips.war_nippon_artifacts_collected_tt: Own at least §Y14 different artifacts§! in our provinces. Multiple artifacts in one province each count; artifacts held by subjects do not.
tooltips.war_nippon_new_world_settlement_tt: A completed New World settlement founded under Nipponese or Nipponese colonial sponsorship.
tooltips.war_nippon_homeland_restored_tt: Every settled province in Nippon is ours or belongs to a loyal non-sovereign subject, and follows our state religion.
tooltips.war_nippon_cathayan_victory_tt: Won a war within 50 years against a surviving Cathayan state with at least 50 development, or hold 8 Cathayan cities directly or through non-sovereign subjects.
tooltips.war_nippon_khureshi_victory_tt: Won a war within 50 years against a surviving Khureshi state with at least 50 development, or hold 8 Khureshi cities directly or through non-sovereign subjects.
tooltips.war_nippon_underworld_victory_tt: Won a war within 50 years against a surviving underground state with at least 50 development, or hold 8 underground cities directly or through non-sovereign subjects.
tooltips.war_nippon_islands_united_tt: Every land province in Nippon is owned by us or by a non-sovereign subject.
tooltips.war_nippon_fourteen_ideas_tt: Have at least 14 unlocked ideas across your selected idea groups.
